facts.fact: The ANINF director-general's slides state that ANINF is responsible for the coherent and coordinated implementation of the national strategy for digital development; the slides do not describe the strategy's scope.

systems.tiers: national; four components: enabling environment, legal identification, digital transformation of public administration and key services, citizen engagement and monitoring

note: The national strategy for digital development is named without a description of its scope, so its class is empty; the slides give it no standing, text, period, plan or reporting.
